records.findings_summary: Flag found via Truncated-PNG height recovery (forensics). The attached PNG IHDR declares height 382, but the concatenated zlib IDAT stream decompresses to 823042 bytes = 418 rows of (492*4+1). The extra 36 rows were hidden below the declared image; unfiltering all 418 rows reveals a Discord input box with the flag.: sun{totallyoriginalchallengeidea} | Evidence: file/pngcheck report 492x382 RGBA PNG with only IHDR/sRGB/gAMA/pHYs/IDAT/IEND chunks; no text chunks, alpha all 255, LSB bit planes empty. ; Decompressed IDAT length 823042 vs expected 382*(492*4+1)=752158; 823042 == 418*(492*4+1), so true height is 418px. ; Unfiltering all 418 scanlines and viewing hidden bottom 36 rows shows the Discord input box: sun{totallyoriginalchallengeidea} (confirmed at 8x zoom). ; Reconstructions saved: /challenge/workspace/full.png and /challenge/workspace/hidden_rows.png.
solution_steps: file/pngcheck 显示 PNG 声明 492x382，但只有标准 chunk，无文本块，alpha 全 255，LSB 位平面为空。
拼接并 zlib 解压全部 IDAT 得到 823042 字节；按行宽 (492*4+1)=1969 计算得到 418 行，而 IHDR 只声明 382 行，图片被裁掉下方 36 行（对应题名 you cut me off）。
按 PNG 滤波规则 0..4 对全部 418 行反滤波，重建 492x418 图像并导出被隐藏的底部 36 行。
放大隐藏区域，Discord 输入框显示 flag：sun{totallyoriginalchallengeidea}。
脚本 /challenge/workspace/solve.py 输出 full.png 与 hidden_rows.png。
evidence: file/pngcheck report 492x382 RGBA PNG with only IHDR/sRGB/gAMA/pHYs/IDAT/IEND chunks; no text chunks, alpha all 255, LSB bit planes empty.
Decompressed IDAT length 823042 vs expected 382*(492*4+1)=752158; 823042 == 418*(492*4+1), so true height is 418px.
Unfiltering all 418 scanlines and viewing hidden bottom 36 rows shows the Discord input box: sun{totallyoriginalchallengeidea} (confirmed at 8x zoom).
